reviews.review:
cute little on rail shooter.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6gcuFr01mSA

the games does have some flaws but its not a bad indie rail shooter. the game has 8 levels counting the tutorial and 2 bosses, 12 guns to upgrade, and some unlockable outfits though limited. it is only about 2hours long though but that's not to bad for the price. 

some issues people have are 1)sometimes you'll get hit even under cover and more so when you try to shoot at these times. 2)there is a laser room some have trouble with because to move you need to click then slide the mouse where you want to go. the store video has enough gameplay to give you a good idea if it looks good enough to buy or not.
